scope: GitHub Pages information architecture and Korean-first UX
user_request: Separate already implemented/verified features from features still being implemented or reviewed.
Make the user-facing Pages primarily Korean because the user is not comfortable reading English.
Make the page understandable to a first-time visitor.
Do not immediately change the live web UI; record the plan in GitHub first so other AI agents understand the upcoming change.
implementation_guardrails: Do not modify src/kmb_lab/pages.py or web/** solely because this handoff exists.
Do not mark an item as 구현 완료 without test/Actions/expected-state evidence.
Keep internal enums stable where useful; translate them only at the user-display layer.
Preserve UNKNOWN/MISSING/NOT COLLECTED semantics and never fabricate display data.
Avoid simultaneous edits to Pages generator while another agent owns an active Pages/UI recovery or task.
Use progressive disclosure: beginner summary first, technical evidence later.

review_requested.AI-A: 시장 정보 우선순위와 사용자 관점 검토
review_requested.AI-B: 완료/진행중 표현의 증거 수준과 과장 여부 검토
review_requested.AI-C: SHADOW/실험/확률 기능이 완료 기능처럼 보이지 않는지 검토
review_requested.AI-D: freshness/recovery/Pages generator 상태 계산과 충돌 여부 검토
review_requested.AI-E: 전체 정보구조, 한국어 UX, 초보자 이해도, 모바일 구조 검토

next_step: Each AI may leave a candidate/review note first. Promote to an implementation task only after the proposal is understood and no conflicting Pages edit is active.
